rationale: Extremely elevated relative volume (19.5x) accompanied the 12.4% gap-up open, with the first candle printing a tall range on over 1M shares that closed near its highs. The follow-on candle shows volume collapsing by more than 95% while price holds at session VWAP, sits 1.1% above the 9-EMA on 5m bars, and sits in the upper 65% of the day's range as the broader tape trades mildly green with falling volatility. This combination of absorption on the pullback and sustained buyer presence above key intraday reference levels supports a long bias with risk defined beneath the 9-EMA.
